tool_args.rationale: The target horizon of 20.4 greatly exceeds the pilot horizons of 0.16–0.48. A slow-horizon observation is needed to identify the adaptation timescale and distinguish sustained gain from reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model from the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify both timescales or determine long-horizon adaptation.
Fine short-window measurements are less directly informative about the target horizon.
The pilot does not establish oscillation, and the long-horizon probe can discriminate the adaptation mechanism.
